name: BANNER OF BRAVERY
originalText:
#### BANNER OF BRAVERY

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Paragons of Virtue
- **Source Page:** 6

```text
Duration: 1 minute
Courage erupts within you, giving you strength and durability
to overcome any challenge. Make an attack with a weapon you
are wielding. Then, for the duration, you emit an aura from a
point in your space that spreads out in a 10-yard radius. The
aura moves with you when you move. You and each ally in the
aura make attack rolls and challenge rolls with 1 boon, become
immune to the charmed, dazed, fatigued, and frightened
afflictions, and your attacks deal 3d6 extra damage.
```

name: JUDGE AND JURY
originalText:
#### JUDGE AND JURY

- **Type:** Attack
- **Source:** Paragons of Virtue
- **Source Page:** 5

```text
Target: One creature within medium range.
You call forth the enemy to make it face its crimes. The target
teleports to the empty space nearest to you and takes 2d6
damage. The target makes a Will challenge roll with 1 bane. On
a failure, the target takes 4d6 extra damage plus 1d6 damage
for each point of Corruption it has. If the target becomes
injured from this damage, it falls prone and cannot stand up
until after the end of your next turn. If the target becomes
incapacitated, its body crumbles to dust, and its soul, if it has
one, tumbles into Hell.
```

name: VALUE OF RESTRAINT

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Paragons of Virtue
- **Source Page:** 6

```text
Duration: 8 hours
You tamp down on your emotions to channel that energy
into more useful ways. Once per round, when you would deal
damage to at least one creature, you can choose to halve the
amount of damage the creature takes. You then heal the same
amount of damage. Then, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, you increase
the number of actions you can use on your next turn by one.
```

name: WEIGHT OF JUSTICE
originalText:
#### WEIGHT OF JUSTICE

- **Type:** Attack
- **Source:** Paragons of Virtue
- **Source Page:** 5

```text
Target: One empty space of your Size that is within reach of
one creature you can see within medium range.
You teleport to the target space and make an attack with
a weapon you are wielding. You make the attack roll with 2
boons, and the attack deals an extra 1d6 damage. If you get
a success on the attack roll, the target falls prone and cannot
stand up until after the end of your next turn.
Triggered: You can cast this spell when a creature within
range deals damage to another creature, but the target for
your attack must be the creature that enabled the casting of
this spell.
```

name: WISE CORRECTION
originalText:
#### WISE CORRECTION

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Paragons of Virtue
- **Source Page:** 6

```text
Duration: 1 hour (see the effect)
You put your mind to work to find a path through this mess.
The next time you get a failure on an attack roll or challenge
roll, you can end the spell immediately to turn the failure into a
success. Then, for 1 minute, you make Intellect and Will attack
rolls and challenge rolls with 2 boons, and you impose 2 banes
on attack rolls against your Intellect and Will.
```
